name: Oveporexton
summary: Oveporexton, sold under the brand name Orzeyful, is a medication used for the treatment of narcolepsy type 1. It is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: Oveporexton acts as a selective agonist of the orexin OX2 receptor. Oveporexton has wakefulness-promoting effects in animals, including in rodents and monkeys. In addition, oveporexton has been found to be effective in the treatment of narcolepsy and cataplexy in phase 3 clinical trials in humans.

uses.text: Oveporexton is indicated for the treatment of narcolepsy type 1 (narcolepsy with cataplexy) in adults. Narcolepsy type 1 is a rare, lifelong neuropsychiatric sleep disorder. It is caused by the loss of brain cells that produce orexin, a chemical messenger that regulates wakefulness, sleep, and muscle tone. Without orexin, the brain struggles to maintain alertness or to control the boundary between sleep and waking.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effects include insomnia, increased urinary frequency, urgency to urinate, and increased saliva production.
